calculation.description: Negative same-day open-to-close return. Assets with weak intraday performance are expected to rebound in the next close-to-close session. Signal uses only completed day t OHLC data.

signal_artifact.data_alignment: Signal at t uses open and close through completed date t; forward return is close[t+1]/close[t]-1; no future data used.

metrics.correlation_note: Not computed in this cycle; deterministic post-Miner gate must recompute pairwise correlation from the signal artifact.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable by broad regimes: 2020-2022 IC 0.04811, annualized ICIR 2.27; 2023-2024 IC 0.05281, annualized ICIR 2.57; 2025-2026 IC 0.04574, annualized ICIR 2.10. Annualized figures are supplementary; admission uses unannualized daily ICIR. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
